funFact: Which animal lineage came first — sponges or comb jellies? This is one of the biggest open questions in animal evolution. For over a century, simple, brainless sponges were assumed to be first. Then in 2008, genomic studies pointed to comb jellies — animals with nerves and muscles. A 2023 chromosome-level study supported comb jellies, a 2025 study supported sponges but was retracted after errors were found, and the debate continues.
